search_text: published ZDI-10-180 ZDI-CAN-658 IBM TSM FastBack Server _SendToLog Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-09-29 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['IBM'] ['Tivoli Storage Manager FastBack'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of IBM Tivoli FastBack Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within FastBackServer.exe which listens by default on tcp port 11406. The issue is due to an unsafe copy to a buffer located on the stack. This buffer is used to build a formatted event log message for the AGI_SendToLog method. Successful exploitation leads to remote code execution under the context of the fastback server. http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21443820 Issue 2 ['2010-01-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2010-09-29 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Sebastian Apelt (www.siberas.de) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-10-180/
title: IBM TSM FastBack Server _SendToLog Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of IBM Tivoli FastBack Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within FastBackServer.exe which listens by default on tcp port 11406. The issue is due to an unsafe copy to a buffer located on the stack. This buffer is used to build a formatted event log message for the AGI_SendToLog method. Successful exploitation leads to remote code execution under the context of the fastback server.
